---
title: "Human Protein Atlas Analysis"
author: "Deepak Dsouza"
---
I am going to determine the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain for humans, pigs and mice, and in the process find which has the highest number
```{r}
human_forebrain <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
pig_forebrain <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
mouse_forebrain <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("Human forebrain:", human_forebrain))
print(paste("Pig forebrain:", pig_forebrain))
print(paste("Mouse forebrain:", mouse_forebrain))
```
The human forebrain had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated gene expression in the forebrain at 430.
